Scholarships & Programs

Education, training & practice for a healthier world

Ecogenesis awards scholarships to those interested in education, training and practice — and funds small-scale projects for women, youth, indigenous people, farmers, churches, and schools.

We maintain a model "backyard" permaculture-designed garden for demonstration, conduct site visits for promotion and consultation, and run a training center for wellness and wholeness. Explore our programs below.
